source: Aaley and Bodt 2020, New Kusunda data: A list of 250 concepts
included: All 662 released CLDF lexemes from all 250 prompts: Gyani Maiya Sen Kusunda, Kamala Khatri (Sen Kusunda), and the authors' tentative ground-form reconstruction.
excluded: Eighty-eight blank or source-marked-empty lect cells produce no released CLDF lexeme. Non-selected alternates remain in the frozen upstream Value and raw comment fields and in the 750-cell audit. Watters 2006 and Aaley 2021 were inspected but are separate sources outside this import.
